_note: DEMO DATA. Every organisation, amount, date and rule below is fictional and exists only to demonstrate the product. Dates are offsets in days from the day the data is loaded.

opportunities.title: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (Demo)
opportunities.summary: Annual support for undergraduate students from lower-income families who keep good grades.
opportunities.description:
This demo scholarship shows how FormSaathi presents a typical merit-cum-means award: an income limit, a minimum academic score and renewal every year.

Selected students receive a yearly amount towards tuition and study costs. Renewal depends on passing every year.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduates, family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh/year, at least 60% in the last exam.
opportunities.benefits: Rs 25,000 per year towards tuition and study expenses, renewable until the course ends.
opportunities.how_to_apply:
1. Create an account on the (demo) portal.
2. Fill the application form and upload documents.
3. Get the form verified by your institution.
4. Submit before the deadline and save the acknowledgement number.

criteria.description: Annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh
At least 60% marks in the previous qualifying exam
Must not be receiving any other scholarship for the same year

documents.notes: Issued in the current financial year
Account in the student's own name

opportunities.title: Women in STEM Scholarship (Demo)
opportunities.summary: One-time award for women pursuing science, technology, engineering or maths degrees.
opportunities.description: A demo award illustrating gender-specific eligibility. It supports women students in STEM courses with a one-time grant and mentoring sessions.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women students in UG/PG STEM courses with CGPA 7.0 or above.
opportunities.benefits: One-time grant of Rs 40,000 plus six mentoring sessions.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Fill the online form, upload documents, and write a 300-word statement on your goals.

opportunities.title: Summer Software Internship (Demo)
opportunities.summary: 8-week remote internship building real features with a product engineering team.
opportunities.description: Work with mentors on web and data projects. Interns ship at least one feature, attend weekly tech talks, and present a demo at the end.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Pre-final or final year UG students in computer-related courses.
opportunities.benefits: Monthly stipend of Rs 15,000 and an internship certificate.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit your resume and a link to one project. Shortlisted students take a 45-minute online assessment.

criteria.description: Computer science or a related course

opportunities.title: Rural Policy Fellowship (Demo)
opportunities.summary: 11-month field fellowship working with district offices on rural development projects.
opportunities.description: Fellows are placed with partner district teams to support programme monitoring and community outreach. Includes training, a monthly fellowship amount and travel support.
opportunities.benefits: Rs 35,000 per month, travel allowance and a completion certificate.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Online application with two short essays, followed by a group discussion and interview.

criteria.description: Graduate in any discipline (final-year students may apply)
Willing to live in a rural district for the full fellowship

opportunities.title: Free Digital Skills Certification (Demo)
opportunities.summary: Free 3-month course in digital literacy, spreadsheets and basic coding with a certificate.
opportunities.description: A state-run (demo) skilling programme for young residents. Classes run on weekends at partner training centres and online.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Maharashtra residents aged 18–35 who have passed Class 10.
opportunities.benefits: Free training, study material, certificate, and placement support.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register online or at the nearest training centre with your documents.

opportunities.title: Post-Matric Study Support (Demo)
opportunities.summary: Fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for SC/ST students after Class 10.
opportunities.description: Demo scheme illustrating category-based eligibility with an income limit. Covers fees and a monthly allowance for students studying after Class 10.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: SC/ST students studying after Class 10, family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh.
opportunities.benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online, then submit the printed form to your institution for verification.

criteria.description: Belongs to SC or ST category
Annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh
Studying in a post-matric (after Class 10) course

opportunities.title: National Engineering Aptitude Test (Demo)
opportunities.summary: Computer-based aptitude test used for admission to partner engineering colleges.
opportunities.description: A demo entrance exam with two sessions a year. Scores are valid for one admission cycle.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Class 12 students or passed Class 12 with Physics and Maths.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register online, pay the exam fee, choose an exam city and download your admit card.

criteria.description: Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects in Class 12

documents.notes: Class 10 marksheet for date of birth

opportunities.title: Graduate Trainee Program (Demo)
opportunities.summary: 12-month paid trainee role in operations or analytics, with a full-time offer on completion.
opportunities.description: Trainees rotate across two teams and receive structured training. High performers are offered full-time roles.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Graduates (any stream) aged up to 26 with 60% or above.
opportunities.benefits: Rs 3.6 lakh per year stipend, health cover, and a possible full-time offer.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online with resume; shortlisted candidates take an aptitude test and two interviews.

opportunities.title: Student Innovation Grant (Demo)
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for student teams building prototypes that solve local problems.
opportunities.description: Teams of 2–4 students submit an idea; selected teams get funding, lab access and mentors for six months.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Teams of currently enrolled UG/PG/diploma students.
opportunities.benefits: Up to Rs 1,00,000 per team, lab access and mentoring.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Submit a 2-page proposal and a 2-minute video. Shortlisted teams pitch to a panel.

criteria.description: Currently enrolled in diploma, UG or PG
Team of 2–4 students from the same institution

opportunities.title: Electrician Apprenticeship (Demo)

opportunities.description: On-the-job training at partner companies with a monthly stipend and a certificate at the end.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: ITI (Electrician) pass-outs aged 18–25 from Maharashtra or Karnataka.
opportunities.benefits: Monthly stipend of Rs 9,000 and an apprenticeship certificate.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Register on the (demo) apprenticeship portal and apply to listed establishments.

opportunities.title: Inclusive Education Scholarship (Demo)
opportunities.summary: Support for students with disabilities, covering fees, devices and readers/writers.
opportunities.description: Demo scholarship showing disability-based eligibility. Covers tuition, assistive devices and exam support costs.
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students with 40% or more disability, any course after Class 10.
opportunities.benefits: Up to Rs 50,000 per year depending on course and support needs.
opportunities.how_to_apply: Apply online with your disability certificate and fee receipts.

criteria.description: Person with benchmark disability (40% or more)
